newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Opal Inc a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Opal Inc a hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it restarted coverage of Opal Inc with a hold rating after the company reported third quarter earnings of $0.34 a share on revenue of $16.4 million, in line with Street consensus.
-- In written research, Hambrecht said it sees Opal shares as a good long term value at a current price around $9.00 a share, or 8.5 times 1997 earnings estimate of $1.18 a share.

-- However, Hambrecht does not see a near term catalyst for appreciation of Opal's shares and is looking for capital spending hikes in the semiconductor equipment industry to raise its rating and earnings estimates.
